show.description: Kavya, a hardworking single mother, never expected her past with the powerful CEO Meher Raichandani to resurface. But when her son Rohan’s truth comes to light, Meher is forced to confront secrets, family rivalries, and Alisha’s schemes. In a battle of love, power, and legacy, will Kavya protect her child or be trapped in Meher’s world? Watch Now!
